name: CleanUpContinuousIntersections
formula: =LAMBDA(verticesWithIntersections,IF(COLUMNS(verticesWithIntersections)<3,INDEX(verticesWithIntersections,1,3),LET(n, ROWS(verticesWithIntersections), isIntersectionArray, CHOOSECOLS(verticesWithIntersections, 3), isIntersectionArray_RepeatBothEnds, VSTACK(CHOOSEROWS(isIntersectionArray, -1), isIntersectionArray, CHOOSEROWS(isIntersectionArray, 1)), modifiedArray, MAP(SEQUENCE(n, 1, 2), LAMBDA(i, IF(AND(INDEX(isIntersectionArray_RepeatBothEnds, i - 1), INDEX(isIntersectionArray_RepeatBothEnds, i), INDEX(isIntersectionArray_RepeatBothEnds, i + 1)), FALSE, INDEX(isIntersectionArray_RepeatBothEnds, i)))), HSTACK(TAKE(verticesWithIntersections, , 2), modifiedArray, DROP(verticesWithIntersections, , 3)))))
comment: Clears intersection flags in the middle of a run of three or more TRUE values. verticesWithIntersections is an n×4 array of x, y, TRUE or FALSE, and a name. The ring is closed, so a run may wrap from the last row to the first. The first and last TRUE of a run stay TRUE. A run of two stays TRUE. Fewer than three columns returns #REF!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
